title: Discounts
description: Manage promotional codes and automatic discounts.

help.title: About Discounts
help.overview: A discount is a code a buyer enters at the cart. The cart holds one code at a time. It is checked again whenever the cart is re-priced and dropped if it no longer qualifies. Title, type, value, scope, and start date are required; the code is stored in uppercase.

sections.title: When the amount is worked out
sections.body: Order of operations in the cart: catalog price → one pricing rule per line → the discount code → shipping → tax.
items: Percentage takes that percent off the lines in scope. Fixed takes a flat amount, never more than those lines are worth.
Free shipping does not reduce merchandise; checkout charges no shipping while it is applied.
Buy X get Y counts eligible units, groups them as buy plus get quantity, and makes the cheapest units in each complete group free. It needs buy quantity, get quantity, and the eligible products.
Gift-card lines are never discounted and never count toward minimums.

sections.title: Scope
items: Order covers every merchandise line. Product, category, or collection covers only the selected targets.
Category matches any category of the product. Collection uses the same membership the storefront shows.
On the platform shop, a cart with several sellers cannot use a seller's code.

sections.title: What blocks a code
items: It must be active and inside its start and end dates; no end date means it never expires.
Usage limit stops it after that many uses. Usage limit per customer counts that customer's non-cancelled orders with the code.
Minimum order amount and minimum quantity count merchandise only, after pricing rules.
Customer groups saved on the discount are not checked when the code is applied.

sections.title: Counting a use
items: A use is counted when the order is placed, not when the code is typed.
If the code stopped qualifying while the buyer paid by card, the order keeps it (refusing would strand the money) and the use is still counted. Unpaid orders are refused instead.
Activate and deactivate switch the code on and off. Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
